name: 2,2'-iminobisethanol N-C12-18-alkyl derivatives
description: 2,2'-Iminobisethanol N-C12-18-alkyl derivatives , identified by CAS 71786-60-2 , is a fatty alkyl diethanolamine surfactant derived from coconut and mixed C12–C18 fatty amines. It functions as an emulsifier, dispersant, and cleaning agent across a range of industrial and consumer formulations. In textile and leather processing, it acts as a softening and dispersing agent, improving dye uptake and fiber lubrication during wet processing. Coatings and adhesive formulators use it to stabilize pigment dispersions and improve substrate wetting in waterborne systems. In industrial and institutional cleaning products, it contributes emulsification of oils and greases, particularly in hard-surface and metal cleaning concentrates. Personal care and home care formulators incorporate it into conditioning rinses and emulsified cleaning bases. The chemical is highly valued where mild surfactancy and compatibility with cationic systems are required. This product is typically supplied as a liquid or low-viscosity paste, depending on temperature and concentration. It is available in technical grade , which is the standard specification for industrial and formulation use. Bulk supply is common in drums and intermediate bulk containers (IBCs), with tank truck quantities available for high-volume buyers. The material provides excellent stability and performance across various pH ranges. Its versatile nature makes it a staple for manufacturers seeking reliable emulsification and wetting properties in complex chemical mixtures.
